notes: S2/F38 (§9.4 validity windows, §9.1 rule 6): the declaration is recorded at T1 and declares valid_from T2, so its own self-signature is outside the window: the declaration is invalid E_KEY_EXPIRED. The §9.4 judgement of the declaration's own signatures decides its verdict only; the declaration still supplies the key's material, class and window (§5.3), so a note signed by the key at T3 is valid.
